module
public import tools.research.ScopeAlternatives
@[expose] public section

namespace Eggshell.Research.ConditionalAlternatives
open Lean Eggshell.Synapses Eggshell.Synapses.CanonicalSource
open Eggshell.Research.ReferenceRequirements

/- Optional observed syntax frames, not inferred call dependencies. No query,
weight, expected answer, Work, Union, completion or IO enters preparation. -/
structure Frame (rows : Array StoredRow) where
  first : Fin rows.size
  last : Fin rows.size
  payload : List (Fin rows.size)
  fileBound : payload.all (fun index => rows[index].key.file == rows[first].key.file) = true
  complete : payload.map (fun index => rows[index].key.line) =
    List.range' rows[first].key.line (rows[last].key.line+1-rows[first].key.line)

theorem Frame.same_file (frame : Frame rows) (index : Fin rows.size)
    (member : index ∈ frame.payload) : rows[index].key.file = rows[frame.first].key.file := by
  exact eq_of_beq (List.all_eq_true.mp frame.fileBound index member)

theorem Frame.original_membership (frame : Frame rows) (index : Fin rows.size)
    (_member : index ∈ frame.payload) : rows[index] ∈ rows.toList := by
  exact List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨index.val,index.isLt,by simp⟩

def matching (tokens : Array (Token size)) : Std.HashMap Nat Nat := Id.run do
  let mut stack : List (String × Nat) := []
  let mut found : Std.HashMap Nat Nat := {}
  for index in List.finRange tokens.size do
    let text := tokens[index].text
    if ["(","[","{"].contains text then stack := (text,index.val)::stack
    else if [")","]","}"].contains text then
      match stack with
      | (opening,first)::rest =>
        if (opening,text) ∈ [("(",")"),("[","]"),("{","}")] then
          found := found.insert first index.val
          stack := rest
        else stack := []
      | [] => pure ()
  return found

/-- A deliberately restricted statement recognizer over observed tokens.
Unrecognised forms, missing delimiters and truncated statements yield none.
This is not a C++ name resolver or a proof of language semantics. -/
def simple : Nat → Array (Token size) → Std.HashMap Nat Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0,_,_,_ => none
  | fuel+1,tokens,pairs,cursor => do
    let token ← tokens[cursor]?
    if token.text == ";" then return cursor+1
    if ["else","}","#"].contains token.text then none
    else
      let next ← if ["(","[","{"].contains token.text then
          (pairs[cursor]?).map (·+1)
        else some (cursor+1)
      simple fuel tokens pairs next

def statement : Nat → Array (Token size) → Std.HashMap Nat Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0,_,_,_ => none
  | fuel+1,tokens,pairs,start => do
    let token ← tokens[start]?
    if token.text == "{" then return (← pairs[start]?)+1
    if token.text == "if" then
      let opening := if (tokens[start+1]?).any (·.text == "constexpr") then start+2 else start+1
      unless (tokens[opening]?).any (·.text == "(") do none
      let endCondition ← pairs[opening]?
      let endThen ← statement fuel tokens pairs (endCondition+1)
      if (tokens[endThen]?).any (·.text == "else") then
        statement fuel tokens pairs (endThen+1)
      else return endThen
    else if ["while","for","switch"].contains token.text then
      unless (tokens[start+1]?).any (·.text == "(") do none
      statement fuel tokens pairs ((← pairs[start+1]?)+1)
    else simple (tokens.size+1) tokens pairs start

def runFrames (rows : Array StoredRow) (order : List (Fin rows.size))
    (raw : Array (Char × Fin rows.size)) : Array (Frame rows) := Id.run do
  let tokens := lex raw 0
  -- The inherited lexer does not implement C++ raw strings. Do not interpret
  -- their contents as statements. Preprocessor-containing frames are omitted.
  if (Array.range tokens.size).any (fun index => (tokens[index]?).any (fun token => token.text == "R" &&
      (tokens[index+1]?).any (·.text == "quoted"))) then return #[]
  let pairs := matching tokens
  let mut result := #[]
  let mut used : Std.HashSet (Nat × Nat) := {}
  for start in List.finRange tokens.size do
    if tokens[start].text != "if" then continue
    let some stop := statement (tokens.size+1) tokens pairs start.val | continue
    if stop ≤ start.val || tokens.size < stop then continue
    if (tokens.extract start.val stop).any (·.text == "#") then continue
    let first := tokens[start].row
    let some closing := tokens[stop-1]? | continue
    let last := closing.row
    if used.contains (first.val,last.val) then continue
    let payload := order.filter fun index => rows[index].key.file == rows[first].key.file &&
      rows[first].key.line ≤ rows[index].key.line && rows[index].key.line ≤ rows[last].key.line
    if fileBound : payload.all (fun index => rows[index].key.file == rows[first].key.file) = true then
      if complete : payload.map (fun index => rows[index].key.line) =
          List.range' rows[first].key.line (rows[last].key.line+1-rows[first].key.line) then
        result := result.push ⟨first,last,payload,fileBound,complete⟩
        used := used.insert (first.val,last.val)
  return result

/-- Gaps and fingerprints split runs before lexing. Preparation consumes only
the acquired canonical rows and is intended for publication, not retrieval. -/
def frames (rows : Array StoredRow) : Array (Frame rows) := Id.run do
  let order := (List.finRange rows.size).mergeSort fun a b =>
    if rows[a].key.file == rows[b].key.file then rows[a].key.line ≤ rows[b].key.line
    else (toJson rows[a].key.file).compress ≤ (toJson rows[b].key.file).compress
  let mut run : Array (Char × Fin rows.size) := #[]
  let mut members := []
  let mut previous : Option (Fin rows.size) := none
  let mut result := #[]
  for index in order do
    let row := rows[index]
    unless previous.any (fun prior => rows[prior].key.file == row.key.file && rows[prior].key.line+1 == row.key.line) do
      result := result ++ runFrames rows members run
      run := #[]
      members := []
    run := run ++ ((row.code++"\n").toList.toArray.map fun char => (char,index))
    members := members ++ [index]
    previous := some index
  return result ++ runFrames rows members run

/-- Append alternatives using the unchanged full-containment cue rule. The
original offers remain in order; the candidate adds no votes or discounts. -/
def prepare (p : SharedCoverage.Problem) (familyCount : Nat)
    (sourceRows : Array (StoredRow × Fin p.costs.size))
    (fileFrames : Std.HashMap File (Fin p.costs.size)) : Option (ScopeAlternatives.Prepared p) := do
  let rows := sourceRows.map Prod.fst
  let sourceAtoms := Std.HashSet.ofArray (sourceRows.map Prod.snd)
  let free := (List.finRange p.costs.size).filter fun atom => atom.val < familyCount && p.costs[atom] == (0,0)
  let mut byAnchor : Std.HashMap (Fin p.costs.size) (List (Fin p.offers.size)) := {}
  for index in List.finRange p.offers.size do
    if let some anchor := p.offers[index].closure.find? sourceAtoms.contains then
      byAnchor := byAnchor.insert anchor (index::byAnchor[anchor]?.getD [])
  let observed := frames rows
  let mut offers := #[]
  let mut inspected := 0
  for frame in observed do
    let file := rows[frame.first].key.file
    let header ← fileFrames[file]?
    let payload ← frame.payload.mapM fun row => (sourceRows[row.val]?).map Prod.snd
    let closure := hashDistinct (free ++ header :: payload)
    let paid := Std.HashSet.ofList closure
    let possible := hashDistinct (closure.flatMap fun atom => byAnchor[atom]?.getD [])
    inspected := inspected+possible.length
    let contained := possible.filter fun index => p.offers[index].closure.all paid.contains
    let covers := hashDistinct (contained.flatMap fun index => p.offers[index].covers)
    if covers.isEmpty then continue
    let charge := closure.foldl (fun total atom => (total.1+p.costs[atom].1,total.2+p.costs[atom].2)) p.fixed
    if p.limit.1 < charge.1 || p.limit.2 < charge.2 then continue
    offers := offers.push ⟨rows[frame.first].key,rows[frame.last].key,frame.payload.length,
      ⟨closure,covers⟩,contained⟩
  return ⟨offers,observed.size,inspected⟩

end Eggshell.Research.ConditionalAlternatives

import Eggshell.CanonicalSourceCache
import tools.SharedCoverageInput
import tools.research.OwnedCoverageAdvance
import tools.research.ConditionalAlternatives
import Lean.Data.Json.Parser
open Lean Eggshell Eggshell.Synapses Eggshell.Synapses.CanonicalSource
namespace ConditionalFrameReplay
def check (value : Bool) (message : String) : IO Unit := unless value do throw (IO.userError message)
def read (path : System.FilePath) : IO Json := IO.FS.readFile path >>= (IO.ofExcept ∘ Json.parse)
def write (path : System.FilePath) (value : Json) : IO Unit := IO.FS.writeFile path value.compress
def fixtureRows (lines : Array String) : Array StoredRow := lines.mapIdx fun index code =>
  ⟨⟨⟨"observed.txt",String.ofList (List.replicate 64 '0'),4096⟩,index+1⟩,code,#[]⟩
def boundaries (rows : Array StoredRow) : Array (Nat × Nat) :=
  (Research.ConditionalAlternatives.frames rows).map fun frame =>
    (rows[frame.first].key.line,rows[frame.last].key.line)
def fixtures : IO Json := do
  let cases : Array (String × Array String × Array (Nat × Nat)) := #[
    ("unbraced alternatives",#["if (available)","  send();","else","  retry();"],#[(1,4)]),
    ("braced and unbraced",#["if (available)","{","  send();","}","else","  retry();"],#[(1,6)]),
    ("nearest dangling else",#["if (outer)","  if (inner)","    send();","  else","    retry();"],#[(1,5),(2,5)]),
    ("constexpr and multiline condition",#["if constexpr (ready &&","              valid(x))","  emit(x);","else {","  report();","}"],#[(1,6)]),
    ("quoted and commented text",#["const char *s = \"if (x) y();\";","// if (x) y();","if (ok) run();"],#[(3,3)]),
    ("truncated statement",#["if (ready)","  send("],#[]),
    ("preprocessor is not a statement",#["#if DEBUG","send();","#endif"],#[]),
    ("unsupported raw string",#["auto s = R\"tag(if (x) y();)tag\";","if (real) run();"],#[]),
    ("empty input",#[],#[]),
    ("unicode identifier",#["if (許可)","  保存();","else","  拒否();"],#[(1,4)]),
    ("loop as then statement",#["if (ready)","  for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) send(i);","else fail();"],#[(1,3)])]
  let mut reports := #[]
  for (name,lines,expected) in cases do
    let actual := boundaries (fixtureRows lines)
    check (actual == expected) ("conditional fixture failed: "++name++" "++(toJson actual).compress)
    reports := reports.push (Json.mkObj [("name",toJson name),("boundaries",toJson actual)])
  let normal := fixtureRows #["if (ready)","  send();","else","  retry();"]
  let some second := normal[1]? | throw (IO.userError "fixture lacks its second original row")
  check ((boundaries (normal.set! 1 {second with key := {second.key with line := 20}})).isEmpty)
    "read gap manufactured a conditional frame"
  check ((boundaries (normal.set! 1 {second with key := {second.key with
    file := {second.key.file with fingerprint := String.ofList (List.replicate 64 '1')}}})).isEmpty)
    "different fingerprint manufactured a conditional frame"
  return Json.mkObj [("cases",toJson reports),("gapRejected",toJson true),
    ("fingerprintSplitRejected",toJson true),("allPassed",toJson true)]

def run (database captured output : System.FilePath) : IO Unit := do
  check (!(← output.pathExists)) "preserve previous conditional replay"
  IO.FS.createDir output
  write (output/"fixtures.json") (← fixtures)
  let source ← DB.PageMap.pin database
  let before ← read (captured/"before-delivery.json")
  check (toJson source.head == before.getObjValD "originalHead") "actual captures use another original source"
  let started ← IO.monoMsNow
  let (registry,statistics) ← CanonicalSource.build source
  let rows := registry.store
  let byKey := Std.HashMap.ofArray (rows.map fun row => (row.key,row))
  let mut topics := #[]
  for topic in [1,2,3] do
    let name := if topic == 1 then "diagnostic" else s!"diagnostic-topic-{topic}"
    check ((← read (captured/name/"validation.json")).getObjValD "sameOrdinaryBody" == toJson true)
      "captured selector changed its actual ordinary body"
    let data ← read (captured/name/"selection.json")
    let raw : SharedCoverage.Input.RawProblem ← IO.ofExcept (fromJson? (data.getObjValD "selectorInput"))
    let p ← IO.ofExcept raw.decode
    check (SharedCoverage.Input.ofProblem p == raw) "selector input did not round-trip exactly"
    let witness := data.getObjValD "selectionWitness"
    let nodes : Array (Nat × Key) ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "sourceNodes")
    let families : Array String ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "owners")
    let expected : Array Nat ← IO.ofExcept (witness.getObjValAs? _ "compiledSelected")
    let began ← IO.monoMsNow
    let some baseline ← IO.lazyPure (fun _ => SharedCoverage.OwnedAdvance.chooseOwned p) |
      throw (IO.userError "production selector refused captured baseline")
    check (baseline.selected.toArray.map Fin.val == expected) "production replay differs from actual chosen sequence"
    let baselineMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-began
    let sourceRows ← nodes.mapM fun (node,key) => do
      let some row := byKey[key]? | throw (IO.userError "captured file row is absent from acquired originals")
      let text := Packet.rowText row
      check (p.costs[node]? == some (text.length,text.utf8ByteSize)) "captured row cost differs from original bytes"
      if inside : node < p.costs.size then return (row,(⟨node,inside⟩ : Fin p.costs.size))
      else throw (IO.userError "source row exceeds actual cost domain")
    let mut fileFrames : Std.HashMap File (Fin p.costs.size) := {}
    for (row,atom) in sourceRows do
      if fileFrames.contains row.key.file then continue
      let first := ((sourceRows.filter (·.1.key.file == row.key.file)).map (·.2.val)).foldl min atom.val
      check (0 < first) "missing file frame before original rows"
      let frame := Packet.fileFrame row.key.file (sourceRows.map Prod.fst |>.filter (·.key.file == row.key.file))
      let text := frame.leading++frame.trailing
      check (p.costs[first-1]? == some (text.length,text.utf8ByteSize)) "actual file frame differs from original costs"
      if inside : first-1 < p.costs.size then fileFrames := fileFrames.insert row.key.file ⟨first-1,inside⟩
      else throw (IO.userError "file frame exceeds actual cost domain")
    let preparationBegan ← IO.monoMsNow
    let some prepared ← IO.lazyPure (fun _ => Research.ConditionalAlternatives.prepare p families.size sourceRows fileFrames) |
      throw (IO.userError "observed conditional alternatives failed original cost binding")
    let preparationMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-preparationBegan
    let candidate := prepared.problem
    check (candidate.costs == p.costs && candidate.weights == p.weights && candidate.fixed == p.fixed &&
      candidate.limit == p.limit) "conditional alternatives changed scoring or budget"
    let choiceBegan ← IO.monoMsNow
    let some chosen ← IO.lazyPure (fun _ => SharedCoverage.OwnedAdvance.chooseOwned candidate) |
      throw (IO.userError "candidate selector refused bounded original problem")
    let choiceMs := (← IO.monoMsNow)-choiceBegan
    let frameRows := sourceRows.map Prod.fst
    let observedFrames := (Research.ConditionalAlternatives.frames frameRows).map fun frame =>
      Json.mkObj [("file",toJson frameRows[frame.first].key.file),
        ("first",toJson frameRows[frame.first].key.line),("last",toJson frameRows[frame.last].key.line)]
    let paid := Std.HashSet.ofList (SharedCoverage.nodes candidate chosen.selected)
    let known := Std.HashSet.ofList (SharedCoverage.cues candidate chosen.selected)
    let currentCost := SharedCoverage.cost candidate chosen.selected
    let alternatives := prepared.scopes.map fun scope => Id.run do
      let closure := hashDistinct scope.offer.closure
      let covers := hashDistinct scope.offer.covers
      let charge := (closure.filter (!paid.contains ·)).foldl
        (fun total atom => (total.1+candidate.costs[atom].1,total.2+candidate.costs[atom].2)) (0,0)
      let gain := (covers.filter (!known.contains ·)).foldl (fun total cue => total+candidate.weights[cue]) 0
      return Json.mkObj [("file",toJson scope.first.file),("first",toJson scope.first.line),
        ("last",toJson scope.last.line),("rows",toJson scope.rows),("containedOffers",toJson scope.contained.length),
        ("gainAfterFinalChoice",toJson gain),("marginalCostAfterFinalChoice",toJson charge),
        ("fitsAfterFinalChoice",toJson (decide (currentCost.1+charge.1 ≤ p.limit.1 &&
          currentCost.2+charge.2 ≤ p.limit.2)))]
    topics := topics.push (Json.mkObj [("topic",toJson topic),("sourceRows",toJson sourceRows.size),
      ("baselineSequenceExact",toJson true),("baselineMs",toJson baselineMs),
      ("recognized",toJson prepared.recognized),("addedAlternatives",toJson prepared.scopes.size),
      ("selectedNewAlternatives",toJson (chosen.selected.countP (fun index => p.offers.size ≤ index.val))),
      ("preparationMs",toJson preparationMs),("selectionMs",toJson choiceMs),
      ("selectedNodes",toJson ((SharedCoverage.nodes candidate chosen.selected).map Fin.val)),
      ("alternatives",toJson alternatives),
      ("observedFrames",toJson observedFrames),
      ("cost",toJson (SharedCoverage.cost candidate chosen.selected)),
      ("preservesCostsWeightsFixedLimits",toJson true)])
  check ((← DB.PageMap.pin database).head == source.head) "read-only replay changed the original source"
  write (output/"plans.json") (Json.mkObj [("source",toJson source.head),("statistics",toJson statistics),
    ("topics",toJson topics),("elapsedMs",toJson ((← IO.monoMsNow)-started)),
    ("goldenOrQuestionsUsed",toJson false),("actualHookCalled",toJson false),
    ("answeringModelCalls",toJson (0 : Nat)),("adopted",toJson false)])
end ConditionalFrameReplay

#print axioms Eggshell.Research.ConditionalAlternatives.Frame.same_file
#print axioms Eggshell.Research.ConditionalAlternatives.Frame.original_membership
def main : List String → IO Unit
  | [database,captured,output] => ConditionalFrameReplay.run (.mk database) (.mk captured) (.mk output)
  | _ => throw (IO.userError "ConditionalFrameReplay ORIGINAL-DB ACTUAL-CAPTURES NEW-OUTPUT")
